data.name: Rahafah
data.gender_notes: Rahafah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rahafah is derived from the root 'rafe' and means 'to elevate' or 'to rise high'. In Islamic tradition, it signifies a companion of the Most High, Allah, a reference to the heavenly journey of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Rahafah carries the meaning “Companion of the Most High” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Rahafah usually hope their child will grow to embody companion of the most high and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To soar high in spirituality, to be close to Allah.
data.etymology: Rahafah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Companion of the Most High.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rahafah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
